items.summary: Risk disposition: blocked for SearchWoot public beta or full launch; counsel_required for upstream data rights and jurisdiction-specific privacy decisions. Exact decision: keep the private-preview gate, do not send rights outreach, do not add affiliate or advertising use, and permit only bounded read-only evidence work. Evidence: Woot documentation confirms API access, endpoints, rate limits, and quota, but not redistribution, storage, historical derivatives, public display, alerts, affiliate, or advertising rights; public terms restrict collection and commercial/public reuse without express written consent. Compliance is technical-only fleet evidence: 35 pass, 20 fail, 6 unknown; this is not certification. Security and operations controls remain unevidenced; accuracy/freshness and measurement gates are blocked. Ordinary reversible growth may continue only when it adds no credentials, permissions, dependencies, data collection, cross-site behavior, or unsupported claims.
